title: Part 7 Ba • Bộ 06: Bảng giá in ấn, Email đặt hàng triển lãm & Hóa đơn sai phí
subtitle: Kiểm tra điều kiện áp mã khuyến mãi EXPO15, ngưỡng miễn phí ship $1,000 và khoản phụ thu in gấp bị tính nhầm.
tips: Với bộ Bảng giá dịch vụ + Email đặt hàng + Hóa đơn, hãy kiểm tra lần lượt 3 hạng mục hay gài bẫy nhất: (1) Mã giảm giá áp đúng món không? (2) Phí giao hàng đúng ngưỡng miễn chưa? (3) Có cộng nhầm phụ phí in gấp (Rush fee) không?

passages.label: Văn bản 1 • Quảng cáo dịch vụ

meta.title: COLORCRAFT PRINT STUDIO — TRADE SHOW PRINTING GUIDE
meta.subtitle: Fast Commercial Printing • Chicago Metro & Nationwide Shipping

paragraphs: Prepare your booth with vibrant, fade-resistant displays from ColorCraft Print Studio:

• Standard Turnaround: 5 business days from artwork approval.
• Rush Production (48-Hour Turnaround): Available for a 20% surcharge calculated on the print subtotal.
• Courier Delivery: Complimentary standard courier delivery on print orders exceeding $1,000; $45 flat fee for orders of $1,000 or less.

Autumn Promotion: Enter promo code EXPO15 to receive 15% off retractable vinyl banner stands! Note: EXPO15 applies exclusively to banner stands and cannot be combined with discounts on brochures, spec cards, or rush fees.

passages.label: Văn bản 2 • Email đặt hàng

meta.subject: Print Order for BioMed Expo — Delivery by Sept 15

paragraphs:
MedCore Diagnostics would like to place the following print order for the BioMed Expo opening on September 17:
• 4 Retractable Vinyl Banner Stands (33" × 80")
• 1,000 Tri-Fold Glossy Brochures
• 500 Laminated Product Spec Cards

Our print-ready PDF artwork is attached and already approved by our brand team. Since we do not need delivery at our Chicago office until Monday, September 15, your standard five-business-day turnaround works perfectly—we do NOT need rush production.
Please remember to apply promotional code EXPO15 to our banner stands and send over the confirmation invoice so we can issue a purchase order today.

Thank you,
Anna Kowalski
Marketing Coordinator, MedCore Diagnostics

passages.label: Văn bản 3 • Hóa đơn xác nhận

meta.title: COLORCRAFT PRINT STUDIO — ORDER CONFIRMATION #CC-5519
meta.subtitle: Date: September 9 • Client: MedCore Diagnostics (Chicago, IL)

paragraphs: Print Subtotal: $1,220.00 | Rush Production Surcharge: $244.00 | Promo Code EXPO15: -$90.00 | Standard Courier Shipping: $0.00 | Total Due: $1,374.00

questions.q: According to the advertisement, what restriction applies to promo code EXPO15?
opts: It is valid only for orders placed with rush production.
It applies exclusively to retractable vinyl banner stands.
It requires a minimum order of 1,000 glossy brochures.
It cannot be used with complimentary courier delivery.
questions.exp: Văn bản 1 (đoạn 3) ghi rõ: 'EXPO15 applies exclusively to banner stands and cannot be combined with discounts on brochures, spec cards, or rush fees.' → Chỉ áp dụng riêng cho chân standee cuốn.

questions.q: In the advertisement, the word "turnaround" is closest in meaning to
questions.exp: Trong cụm 'Standard Turnaround: 5 business days from artwork approval' và '48-Hour Turnaround', 'turnaround' chỉ khoảng thời gian hoàn thành xử lý/sản xuất đơn hàng → đồng nghĩa với 'processing time'.

questions.q: Why was MedCore Diagnostics charged $0.00 for standard courier shipping?
opts: Ms. Kowalski agreed to pick up the materials at the studio.
Promo code EXPO15 automatically waives all courier fees.
The company's print subtotal exceeded the $1,000 free-shipping threshold.
The delivery address was located inside the BioMed Expo hall.
questions.exp: Nối chéo Văn bản 1 & 3: Văn bản 1 quy định miễn phí giao hàng tiêu chuẩn cho đơn in vượt $1,000 ('exceeding $1,000'). Văn bản 3 cho thấy Print Subtotal là $1,220.00 (> $1,000) nên phí ship bằng $0.00.

questions.q: What billing mistake appears on Order Confirmation #CC-5519?
opts: The EXPO15 discount was omitted from the banner stands.
Too many packs of Tri-Fold Glossy Brochures were billed.
Standard courier shipping was mistakenly charged at $45.
A 48-hour rush production surcharge was wrongly added.
questions.exp: Nối chéo cả 3 văn bản: Văn bản 2 cô Kowalski nhấn mạnh rõ 'standard five-business-day turnaround works perfectly—we do NOT need rush production'. Tuy nhiên hóa đơn ở Văn bản 3 lại tính thêm mã RS-48 '48-Hour Rush Production Surcharge (20%)' trị giá $244.00 (định nghĩa ở Văn bản 1). Còn mã EXPO15 giảm 15% × $600 = $90 và 2 gói 500 tờ rơi (= 1,000 tờ) đều hoàn toàn đúng!

questions.q: Once the billing error is corrected, what should MedCore Diagnostics's final total due be?
questions.exp: Nối chéo cả 3 văn bản: Tổng tiền in = $1,220.00 (đủ miễn phí ship > $1,000); trừ mã EXPO15 hợp lệ cho 4 banner (15% × $600 = -$90.00); bỏ khoản phụ thu in gấp bị tính nhầm (-$244.00) → Tổng thanh toán đúng là $1,220.00 − $90.00 = $1,130.00 (hoặc $1,374.00 − $244.00 = $1,130.00).

paraphrases.vi: thời gian hoàn tất xử lý đơn hàng
chỉ áp dụng riêng cho chân banner

paraphrases.text: complimentary standard courier delivery on orders exceeding $1,000
paraphrases.vi: miễn phí giao hàng cho đơn trên $1,000

paraphrases.text: we do NOT need rush production
paraphrases.answer: rush production surcharge was wrongly added
paraphrases.vi: không cần in gấp ↔ bị cộng nhầm phụ phí in gấp
1.000 tờ rơi gấp ba ↔ 2 gói loại 500 tờ
tổng hóa đơn trừ khoản phí in gấp sai bằng $1,130
